output_list.criticism: The airdrop function has several problems. First, it is not limited to one-time-use. Second, it doesn't provide any protection for the contract owner. Third, it is extremely costly and can cause a gas war. The owner of the contract can set the gas price and amount of tokens to be airdropped for the transaction. Lastly, the airdrop can lead to a devaluing of the token.
